abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: The purpose of the study is to determine the significance of elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) in the setting prior to residual tumor resection (RTR) following chemotherapy for metastatic germ cell tumor in terms of the prediction of histology of the specimen and postoperative survival. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective review of 68 patients undergoing RTR for metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor or extragonadal germ cell tumor after at least a first-line chemotherapy. Pretreatment and postchemotherapy serum markers were evaluated in association with other clinical findings including results of pathological examination of RTR specimen and surgical outcome. RESULTS: Of the 68 study patients, 54 (79%) and 45 (66%) had positive AFP and beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (beta-HCG) in pretreatment settings. Rates of presence of residual malignant cell in RTR specimen were similar between patients with normal AFP (7/28 or 25%) and with mildly elevated (10-30 ng/ml) AFP (3/11 or 27%). In 26 patients who had residual viable malignancy in RTR specimen, patients with preoperative positive AFP had significantly better survival (P = 0.02) compared to those with preoperative positive beta-HCG. CONCLUSIONS: Sole and mild elevation of AFP is not always associated with postoperative poor prognosis. It should be carefully considered individually whether a mild elevation of AFP after chemotherapy represents residual malignancy or benign pathogenesis.
abstract_ja:
背景と目的：本研究の目的は、転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の残存腫瘍切除術の直前における血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)上昇の意義を、切除検体の組織型と術後生存の予測の観点から検討することである。
方法：転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍または性腺外胚細胞腫瘍に対し、少なくとも一次化学療法後に残存腫瘍切除術を受けた68例を後方視的に検討した。術前治療前後の血清腫瘍マーカーを、残存腫瘍切除術の病理学的検査結果や手術成績などの臨床所見と併せて評価した。
結果：68例中、治療前にAFPは54例（79%）、β-hCGは45例（66%）で陽性だった。残存悪性細胞の割合は、AFP正常例（28例中7例、25%）と軽度上昇例（10〜30 ng/ml、11例中3例、27%）で同程度だった。切除検体に残存生存性悪性腫瘍を認めた26例のうち、術前AFP陽性例は術前β-hCG陽性例に比べ有意に良好な生存を示した（P=0.02）。
結論：AFPの単独かつ軽度の上昇が、術後の予後不良と常に関連するわけではない。化学療法後の軽度のAFP上昇が残存悪性腫瘍を示すのか、良性の病態によるのかは、個別に慎重に判断すべきである。
